eu_regulation.usage_note: Directly applicable across the Union. Level 1.

eu_directive.usage_note: Binding on Member States, applied through national law. Only anchors relations here; the prototype shows none as its own row.

eu_guidance.usage_note: ESA guidelines and Q&As. Comply or explain, applied by the national supervisor.

act.usage_note: A statute passed by the national legislature (SFS in Sweden). Jurisdiction comes from the instrument, never from the level.

authority_regulation.usage_note: Binding rules issued by the supervisor under delegation (FFFS in Sweden).

standard.usage_note: One edition of a published standard, such as ISO/IEC 27001:2022, filed under International and a regime. Not law: its pill reads Standard, never Guidance, comply or explain. Its text is licensed and never held here, so it has no provisions, only its public facts and one conformance duty in our own words.

proposal.usage_note: A draft rule or final report proposed for adoption. Dates are proposed, not decided.

adopted.usage_note: Decided by the legislator or authority, application still ahead. The prototype's 'Adopted rule', 'EU legislation' and 'EU regulation' land here until they apply.

supervision.usage_note: Surveys, thematic reviews, supervisory statements. No new rule.

enforcement.usage_note: A decision against a named firm. Structured facts live in enforcement_decision.

recurring_date.usage_note: A date the law repeats every year, such as a rate fixing or a reporting deadline.

consultation.usage_note: A draft open for comments with a closing date. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

in_force.usage_note: The rule applies from the date given. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

guidance.usage_note: Guidelines, Q&As, circulars and position papers from an authority. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

court_ruling.usage_note: A judgment that settles how a rule reads. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

monitor.usage_note: Nothing to do yet, watch for the next step.

ai.usage_note: The change concerns artificial intelligence in financial services, including the AI Act.

advice_perimeter.usage_note: The change moves the line between advice and non-advised services.

conduct.usage_note: How the firm must act towards the client.

disclosure.usage_note: What the client must be told, and when.

record_keeping.usage_note: What must be documented and kept.

reporting.usage_note: What must be sent to an authority.

technical.usage_note: A rule a system enforces, such as eligibility of an asset.

regime.usage_note: The body of law: banking, payments, securities, insurance, tax, data protection, AML, AI and ICT.

account_type.usage_note: The Swedish account wrappers: ISK, AF, depå, KF, pension.

service_type.usage_note: The investment or insurance service offered.

channel.usage_note: Digital or branch. Describes the obligation, never narrows the footprint.

lifecycle_stage.usage_note: Where in the client or product lifecycle the duty bites. Descriptive only.

compliant.usage_note: We meet the obligation and can show it.

partly_compliant.usage_note: Met in part; the status note says what is missing.

gap.usage_note: Not met. A gap record with an owner and a date is expected.

low.usage_note: Tenant scale, mapped to a fixed ordinal.

medium.usage_note: Tenant scale, mapped to a fixed ordinal.

high.usage_note: Tenant scale, mapped to a fixed ordinal.

implements.usage_note: National law that transposes or gives effect to an EU directive.

elaborates.usage_note: Guidance or delegated rules that detail a higher instrument.

related.usage_note: Two obligations a reader should see together, with no hierarchy between them.

amends.usage_note: A later instrument that corrects, supersedes or adds to part of an earlier one.

authority_site.usage_note: The publisher's own site, checked on a schedule.

open_web_sweep.usage_note: A search across the open web for anything the registered sources missed.

tenant_private.usage_note: A source only one tenant follows. Findings never enter the shared library.

standards_body.usage_note: A standards publisher's own pages. Registered with automated checks off until a lawyer has read the publisher's terms (D-45).

control.usage_note: A recurring control or sample test.

obligation_versions.summary_en: Before providing a non-advised service in a complex financial instrument, the institution asks about the client's knowledge and experience and assesses whether the service or product is appropriate. If it is not appropriate, or information is missing, the client is warned.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Innan en tjänst utan rådgivning tillhandahålls i ett komplicerat finansiellt instrument ska institutet begära uppgifter om kundens kunskap och erfarenhet och bedöma om tjänsten eller produkten passar kunden. Om den inte passar, eller om uppgifter saknas, ska kunden varnas.

obligation_versions.summary_en: When giving investment advice, the institution obtains information on the client's knowledge, experience, financial situation and objectives, including sustainability preferences, and recommends only what is suitable. The reasons are documented and given to the client.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Vid investeringsrådgivning ska institutet inhämta uppgifter om kundens kunskap, erfarenhet, ekonomiska situation och mål, inklusive hållbarhetspreferenser, och bara rekommendera det som är lämpligt. Skälen ska dokumenteras och lämnas till kunden.

obligation_versions.summary_en: Warnings given after an appropriateness assessment are clear, prominent and not misleading. The firm does not downplay a warning or encourage the client to proceed despite it, and keeps records of warnings and of whether the client went ahead.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Varningar efter en passandebedömning ska vara tydliga, framträdande och inte vilseledande. Företaget får inte tona ned en varning eller uppmuntra kunden att gå vidare trots den, och ska dokumentera varningar och om kunden ändå genomförde affären.

obligation_versions.summary_en: Clients receive aggregated information on all costs and charges of the service and the instrument in good time before the service, and at least annually afterwards, with the effect of costs on return.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Kunder ska i god tid få sammanställd information om alla kostnader och avgifter för tjänsten och instrumentet, och därefter minst årligen, med kostnadernas effekt på avkastningen.

obligation_versions.summary_en: Research from third parties may be received only if it is paid from the institution's own resources, from a research payment account, or jointly with execution under the conditions set out in the rules.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Investeringsanalys från tredje part får tas emot endast om den betalas med institutets egna medel, från ett analyskonto, eller gemensamt med orderutförande enligt de villkor som anges i reglerna.

obligation_versions.summary_en: For every financial instrument manufactured or distributed, the institution defines a target market, checks that the distribution strategy fits it, and reviews both regularly.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: För varje finansiellt instrument som produceras eller distribueras ska institutet fastställa en målgrupp, säkerställa att distributionsstrategin passar den och regelbundet se över båda.

obligation_versions.summary_en: Clients' financial instruments and funds are kept separate from the institution's own, records allow each client's holdings to be identified at any time, and holdings are reconciled regularly.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Kunders finansiella instrument och medel ska hållas åtskilda från institutets egna, registren ska när som helst visa varje kunds innehav, och innehaven ska stämmas av regelbundet.

obligation_versions.summary_en: Only approved investment assets may be held on an investment savings account. Assets that stop qualifying must be moved out within the period the act allows.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: På ett investeringssparkonto får endast godkända investeringstillgångar förvaras. Tillgångar som upphör att vara godkända ska flyttas från kontot inom den tid lagen anger.

obligation_versions.summary_en: The institution calculates the standard income for each investment savings account and reports it to Skatteverket in the annual control statement.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Institutet ska beräkna schablonintäkten för varje investeringssparkonto och lämna den till Skatteverket i den årliga kontrolluppgiften.

obligation_versions.summary_en: Before an insurance-based investment product is concluded, the distributor specifies the customer's demands and needs and, when advising, assesses whether the product and its underlying assets are suitable.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Innan ett avtal om en försäkringsbaserad investeringsprodukt ingås ska distributören klargöra kundens krav och behov och, vid rådgivning, bedöma om produkten och dess underliggande tillgångar är lämpliga.

obligation_versions.summary_en: When advice involves switching underlying investments, the distributor documents why the benefits of the switch outweigh its costs and gives the customer an explanation of how the advice meets their preferences and objectives.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: När rådgivningen innebär byte av underliggande placeringar ska distributören dokumentera varför fördelarna med bytet överväger kostnaderna och förklara för kunden hur rådet motsvarar kundens önskemål och mål.

obligation_versions.summary_en: Retail customers receive a key information document for the packaged or insurance-based investment product in good time before they are bound by a contract.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Icke-professionella kunder ska få ett faktablad för den paketerade eller försäkringsbaserade investeringsprodukten i god tid innan de blir bundna av ett avtal.

obligation_versions.summary_en: A policyholder may transfer the value of a pension insurance to another insurer. Fees for the transfer are limited by law.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: En försäkringstagare har rätt att flytta värdet av en pensionsförsäkring till en annan försäkringsgivare. Avgifterna för flytten är begränsade i lag.

obligation_versions.summary_en: The financial entity maintains an up-to-date register of all contractual arrangements with ICT third-party service providers and identifies those supporting critical or important functions.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Den finansiella entiteten ska föra ett aktuellt register över alla avtal med tredjepartsleverantörer av IKT-tjänster och ange vilka som stöder kritiska eller viktiga funktioner.

obligation_versions.summary_en: A person has the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing that significantly affects them, unless an exception applies and safeguards such as human intervention are in place.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: En person har rätt att inte bli föremål för ett beslut som enbart grundas på automatiserad behandling och som i betydande grad påverkar personen, om inte ett undantag gäller och skyddsåtgärder som mänskligt ingripande finns.

obligation_versions.summary_en: Before a transaction is carried out after investment advice, the institution gives a retail client a suitability statement. The statement sets out the advice given and how it meets the client's preferences, objectives and other characteristics. It is provided in a durable medium.
obligation_versions.summary_sv: Innan en transaktion genomförs efter investeringsrådgivning ska institutet ge en icke-professionell kund en lämplighetsförklaring. Förklaringen anger vilka råd som lämnats och hur de motsvarar kundens preferenser, mål och andra egenskaper. Den lämnas på ett varaktigt medium.

regulatory_changes.title: FI adopts amended rules on paying for investment research
regulatory_changes.summary: FI's board decided on 15 September 2026 to amend three regulations in the securities area following changed EU rules. Institutions that receive research must set criteria for an annual assessment of its quality, usability and value, and take action if the research does not contribute to better investment decisions.
regulatory_changes.so_what_draft: Teams that pay for external research should confirm that documented criteria for an annual quality assessment exist before the rules take effect. Two weeks of runway.

regulatory_changes.title: FI starts mapping how financial firms use AI
regulatory_changes.summary: FI launched a survey-based mapping of AI use in financial firms on 3 September 2026, including how firms are affected by the AI Act. A report and supervisory follow-up can be expected.
regulatory_changes.so_what_draft: No obligation changes yet. Expect questions on governance of AI in customer-facing services and in software development, so keep the AI tooling register current.

regulatory_changes.title: ESMA proposes shorter pre-settlement timeframes ahead of T+1
regulatory_changes.summary: ESMA has proposed that shorter timeframes for allocation and confirmation apply from 7 December 2026, as a step towards T+1 settlement in October 2027. Status of adoption should be confirmed.
regulatory_changes.so_what_draft: Order handling and custody teams should check whether same-day allocation and confirmation is achievable for all account types.

regulatory_changes.title: Retail Investment Strategy moves towards publication
regulatory_changes.summary: Political agreement was reached on 18 December 2025 and Member States approved the text on 12 June 2026. Transposition is due 24 months and application 30 months after publication, with PRIIPs changes after 18 months.
regulatory_changes.so_what_draft: The package touches appropriateness, costs, inducements and marketing at once. Start the gap analysis now, since level 2 work will fix the detail during 2027.

regulatory_changes.title: AMLR applies directly across the EU
regulatory_changes.summary: Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 replaces national customer due diligence rules with directly applicable requirements from 10 July 2027.
regulatory_changes.so_what_draft: Onboarding and periodic review data must be mapped against the new requirements well before mid-2027.

regulatory_changes.title: FI sanctions Garantum over advice on complex products
regulatory_changes.summary: FI issued remarks and sanctions of 15 MSEK and 1 MSEK for deficient suitability explanations and undocumented switching, under both the securities and the insurance distribution rules.
regulatory_changes.so_what_draft: Confirms that switch documentation is enforced for assets inside insurance wrappers. Our sample test covered it.

regulatory_changes.title: Riksgälden fixes the government borrowing rate used for ISK and KF tax
regulatory_changes.summary: The rate on 30 November sets the standard income for the following tax year. The tax-free base level is 300 000 SEK from 2026.
regulatory_changes.so_what_draft: Customer communication and the tax calculator need the new rate in early December.

regulatory_changes.title: EU moves to T+1 settlement
regulatory_changes.summary: Securities transactions settle one business day after trade date from 11 October 2027.
regulatory_changes.so_what_draft: Funding, FX and corporate action cut-offs all move. Plan testing with the custodian during 2027.
